description.text: Beginning Set National Dex Version, released on 20 April 2012, a Beginning Set with all-new cards. Its three ready-built 30-card half decks, the Snivy, Tepig and Oshawott decks, put Pokémon from outside the Unova Pokédex, such as Pikachu and Meowth, beside Serperior, Emboar and Samurott. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a how-to-play DVD and a rule book came with it.
